{"consolidated_memory":"## Empty Result Set in search/query/rewriter.ts - Three Separate Occasions

**Component**: search/query/rewriter.ts (search side)
**Common Symptom Across All**: Empty result set in query rewriter; rewritten query with no clauses left
**Common Reproduction**: Search for a two-word phrase with a stop word
**Test Coverage**: search/query/rewriter.test.ts (TypeScript)

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-27] - Environment File Misconfiguration
**Trigger**: Only affected clients still pinned to v1 SDK
**Root Cause**: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
**Fix**: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #1285, branch fix/empty-result-set-1)
**Outcome**: Flaky test went from 48 failures per hundred runs to zero

### Occasion 2: [2026-02-16] - Mutable Default Argument
**Trigger**: Only appeared after client had already retried once
**Root Cause**: Mutable default argument shared across calls
**Fix**: Made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #2369, branch fix/empty-result-set-2)
**Outcome**: 65 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

### Occasion 3: [2026-02-27] - Unwrapped Transaction Writes
**Trigger**: Only appeared after a rolling restart of the fleet
**Root Cause**: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
**Fix**: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #3328, branch fix/empty-result-set-3)
**Outcome**: Reclaimed 58 GB of blob storage"}
